NPR’s David Greene is suing Google over its AI podcast voice.

The former host of _Morning Edition_ and current host of _Left, Right & Center_ claims that Google illegally replicated his voice for its male podcast host in NotebookLM. Google denies this, but Greene (and many of his friends and colleagues) say the resemblance is “uncanny.” As the [_Washington Post_](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/02/15/david-greene-google-ai-podcast/) reports:

> To Greene, the resemblance of the AI voice to his own is uncanny — and the harm is deeper and more personal than just a missed chance to capitalize on his most recognizable asset.
>
> “My voice is, like, the most important part of who I am,” Greene said.
